entityRef.description: A reference to something that may not have an account yet. `name` is always written so a record is complete on its own; `uri`/`did` appear only once the thing has been claimed. Reconciling an unclaimed reference to a later account is the app view's job — records are signed by their authors and are never rewritten. This is the hybrid of the authoritative and unauthoritative reference patterns.

name.description: Human-readable name, exactly as the author knew it.

uri.description: Record this refers to, once one exists.

cid.description: Version of that record, pinning what was referenced.

did.description: Account that owns the referenced thing, once claimed.

domain.description: Domain the entity is known by (a bar's website). The strongest reconciliation key available: a business that proves its domain as an atproto handle is that business.

venueRef.description: Where something was drunk. Location encodings come from community.lexicon.location.* so that any app speaking that vocabulary agrees about which place is meant, without anyone owning a registry of places.

address.description: Preferred: community.lexicon.location.fsq, whose Foursquare Open Places id lets two apps agree on a venue with no coordination.

drinkRef.description: What was drunk. A drink category (a Negroni) is folklore and is deliberately NOT ownable: it is a slug in an open catalog. A *recipe* — a specific authored formulation — is ownable, and is referenced through `recipe`.

name.description: As printed or as ordered, including a house name.

slug.description: Canonical catalog key for the folk category, e.g. `negroni`. Unowned by design.

recipe.description: The authored spec this pour followed, if known.

stimulus.description: Objective chemometric and physiochemical parameters of the drink.
Objective physiochemical parameters of a liquid matrix.

residualSugarGpl.description: Residual sugar measured in grams per liter (g/L).

acidityPh.description: Acidity measured on the pH scale.

astringencyIndex.description: Index representing polyphenol / tannin density and salivary PRP precipitation potential.

credit.description: Attribution for a person involved in a drink. Deliberately carries no score: this is a byline, not a rating. Ratings attach to recipes (works), never to people. See docs/data-model.md.

role.description: maker: poured this drink. author: designed the recipe. adapter: reworked someone else's.
